verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a `channel_separation` option that transcribes the left and right channels of a stereo input independently and tags each segment with a channel number. The synchronous transcribe endpoint documents this control, and its response returns channel labels with timing, so each side of a stereo call stays separate. missing for 10: evidence of support beyond two channels (true multichannel), confirmation that channel separation works in batch and live modes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
